title: world.regions
description: Several games (MULTI_GAME_PLAN §4.6, MG3): the world's region table and records, in parts on join before the regions' world.index parts: the text of {"version":1,"world":"<id>","table":{...regions.json...},"regions":[<region record>...],"start"?:"<region>","games"?:[{"game","region"}...]}. A legacy world sends one implicit record for kanto. Ids, numbers and hashes only. WORLD_SESSIONS_PLAN WS2: start and games are the world record (kantobridge/world.json, protocol/world/world.schema.json); without one, the server derives them from the table (start: slot 0's region).
